body: as far as I can see this story doesn't actually depend on client, I would make this the TicTacToeBoard story and use `TicTacToeBoard.*` components directly in the story to make it clear that this doesn't depend on a database. Generally our container stories depend on higher level things like the database or plugin manager. If there are some scenarios which are specific to the TicTacToeArticle container then it's fine to have this as well, but best to have story for just the component which doesn't depend on integration.
